name: laywill-github-io
description: v1 of williamlay.co.uk. A 2017 HTML5 UP 'Story' template, hand-edited since. There is no bundler and no framework: the HTML is served as authored. There are two build-time transforms: compiling assets/sass/ to assets/css/main.css, and resizing/recompressing images (see scripts/optimize-images.mjs) during deploy. The sass version is pinned exactly, not with a caret: the pre-commit hook, CI and any local build must all use the same compiler or they disagree about what main.css should contain.

scripts.css:check: npm run css && git diff --exit-code -- assets/css/main.css
